acceptance: Every executable operation carries evidence sources, a passing verification witness whose app, variant class and version range cover the source binding, an authorized context, a determinate effect and verified uncertainty.

positive.fixture: an active contract with an applicable passing witness is valid

negative.fixture: failed, missing, wrong-variant, wrong-app and too-narrow-range witnesses each block activation

security_and_source_permissions: Writes require a source session, VSF caller authentication, freshness and verification; confirmation is required from non-idempotent writes upward.
performance_memory_storage: Witness applicability is a version-range containment check.
known_limitations: Witness execution itself arrives with the verifier work in later batches
